The floor is real: the harness runs the hook with whatever `python3` the
PATH resolves to, which on a stock macOS is 3.9.6. A PEP-604 annotation
evaluated at runtime, or a 3.10+ stdlib call, is a hook that raises on
import — and the harness reports that as nothing at all.
`include` is an explicit file list, and the rule for it is: every file
the HOOK can reach at import time, and nothing else. A module the hook
grows an import of belongs here on the same commit; a module that merely
imports the hook does not, since nothing puts it in front of the
harness's interpreter. Everything else is covered by pyrightconfig.json,
which includes src/ tests/ tools/ wholesale.
